acceptance_criteria.criterion: Governance-reconcile completion immediately triggers a live-state sweep of open PRs; default-branch workflow SHA is never treated as a candidate head.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The workflow subscribes to Hunter Governance Review Reconcile and candidate_prs() identifies that publisher before SHA attribution, returning open_pull_requests(). The focused RED test failed on the previous head and passes on this head.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Ordinary dependency completions remain attributed to their exact candidate head.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The ordinary workflow_run path remains unchanged after the publisher-specific branch and its focused regression proves an unassociated CI completion calls open_prs_for_head(head_sha), never the sweep.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unresolved review threads and fixed blocking threads without an evidence-bearing reply cannot satisfy Ready/merge state.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Merge Readiness fails closed without a complete exact-head review on the current PR head and re-verifies it with candidate admission's verify_claims (hunter_merge_readiness_v2.review_authority_state). Codex is the required primary authority; the canonical OpenCode hostile review is an admissible fallback only when it records why Codex could not review and that Governance, trusted Preflight, a zero unresolved-thread count and complete structured evidence were green at review time; the recorded authority head must equal the candidate head. A resolved finding counts only with structured resolution evidence naming the exact-head correction commit and a committed regression test. Regression tests cover no-review, stale-review, unresolved-finding, resolved-without-structured-evidence, silent-Codex-skip, forged-fallback, and new-commit-stales states.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Detection never resolves a GitHub thread automatically and does not block non-blocking review suggestions.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: No path resolves a GitHub thread: detection only reads thread resolution state and review-claims findings. Non-blocking findings remain non-blocking; only unresolved blocking findings and missing structured resolution evidence block.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Historical findings are mapped to an existing family or added only with verified source, correction, regression test, and applicability.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The recurring-defect family DFF-022 is updated in place (id preserved) to title merge-readiness-without-current-head-review-authority, with source (Issue #467), verified applicability scope now also covering the canonical registry itself, a prevention mechanism at the hosted-gate boundary, and sixteen resolvable regression tests; the Defect Prevention Guard revalidates the family and its evidence.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Applicable known-defect regression selectors are deterministic, deduplicated, and fail closed when evidence is missing or fails.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The DFF-022 regression evidence consists of deterministically named, deduplicated pytest targets all resolvable in the candidate; the Defect Prevention Guard fails closed if any family evidence or regression target is missing or unreadable, and it validated this candidate's registry and CODE_WRITE_POLICY fields.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The pre-push boundary does not run the full repository suite; hosted Pre-PR remains its sole owner.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: No pre-push or validation-stage implementation changed. The normal hook ran the existing push-safety lane and explicitly delegated full proof to hosted Pre-PR; hosted run 34719386455 passed on exact head 3978822e5e5dcf35aea798b7c21287c7ab763a3f.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Adversarial tests cover stale events, missing associations, pagination/API uncertainty, path-prefix traps, duplicate selectors, and invalid evidence.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Adversarial coverage spans stale/default-branch workflow events, missing associations, no-review and stale-review states, unresolved findings, resolved-without-structured-evidence, new-commit invalidation after either authority, an unrecognised authority type, a silent Codex skip, an older-head fallback, recorded non-green fallback gates, malformed/forged authority metadata, and dropped/malformed CODE_WRITE_POLICY review-authority fields in the guard.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No merge occurs without explicit owner approval.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The contribution is a Draft PR and adds no merge, auto-merge, Ready promotion or deployment capability.

authority.fallback_reason: Codex (the primary review authority) was not usable at review time in this environment; the canonical OpenCode hostile-review tooling recorded the exact-head review instead.

the hostile-review artifact remains excluded from its own reviewed change set; binding is content-based

unavailable/absent/stale review evidence publishes failure, never pending-for-a-passing-state; no transient is relabelled
structured resolution evidence binds correction commit and regression test to the candidate range
no validation-proof or receipt identity semantics were changed; reuse of the governance verify path preserves the single implementation
the extended CODE_WRITE_POLICY validation is structurally pure and runnable in the trusted environment; guard passed on the candidate head
no runtime bootstrap or issuer composition surface changed
no issue-agent execution ownership surface changed in this range
no issuer shutdown/drain surface changed in this range
